login.title: Sign in to Tallyvane
login.lead: Your job search, on the record. New here? The same button creates your account.
login.fineprint: We only use Google to confirm who you are. Tallyvane never sees your Google password.
login.failed: We couldn't reach Google just now. Try again in a moment.
login.problemRestart: That sign-in took a wrong turn. Start again, please.
login.problemExpired: That sign-in took too long and timed out. Start again, please.
login.problemCancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
login.problemRefused: Google didn't let us confirm who you are. Try again, or use another Google account.
login.problemEmailUnverified: Google hasn't verified that email address, so we can't use it. Verify it with Google, or use another account.
login.problemUnavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

continue.title: Signing you in
continue.failed: We couldn't finish signing you in.
continue.closeTab: You're signed in. You can close this tab.
continue.ended: That sign-in has ended. Start again, please.
continue.blocked: This account can't sign in yet.

welcome.title: Welcome to Tallyvane
welcome.signedInAs: Signed in with Google as {email}. One more step.
welcome.name: Your name
welcome.consentTail: , including how Tallyvane stores information about people I add, such as recruiters and contacts.
welcome.nameInvalid: Enter the name you'd like us to use.
welcome.failed: We couldn't create your account. Try again in a moment.

reauth.title: Your session expired
reauth.lead: Sign in again to continue. Your unsaved work is still here, and we'll finish saving it right after.
reauth.different: Signing in as a different person will discard these changes.
reauth.failed: We couldn't reach Google just now.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.lead: This can't be undone, so we need you to sign in with Google once more. If you use an authenticator app, we'll ask for a code in the window that opens. The page behind stays as it is.
stepUp.failed: We couldn't reach Google just now.

stepUpContinue.title: Confirming it's you
stepUpContinue.done: Confirmed. You can close this tab.
stepUpContinue.otherAccount: That was a different Google account. Close this tab and try again with the one you are signed in with.
stepUpContinue.lead: If you use an authenticator app, we ask for a code too.
stepUpContinue.ended: That confirmation has ended. Close this tab and try again.
stepUpContinue.recoveryUsed: You used a recovery code, so your authenticator app no longer works. Set it up again in Settings, Security.

devices.refreshFailed: We couldn't refresh the list, so it may be out of date.
devices.actionFailed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
devices.nameInvalid: A name is 1 to 60 characters, with no control characters.
devices.nameFailed: We couldn't save that name. Try again in a moment.

verify.title: Enter your code
verify.lead: One more step to finish signing in.
verify.failed: We couldn't check your sign-in just now. Try again in a moment.
verify.ended: That sign-in has ended. Start again, please.
verify.blocked: This account can't sign in yet.

secondFactor.codeHint: Six digits from your authenticator app.
secondFactor.recoveryHint: Ten characters, like ABCDE-FGHJK. Each code works once.
secondFactor.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Check your app and try again.
secondFactor.wrongRecovery: That recovery code didn't work. Check it and try again.
secondFactor.paused: Too many tries. Try again in {seconds} s.
secondFactor.pausedAnnouncement: Too many tries. You can try again in {seconds} seconds.
secondFactor.failed: We couldn't check that code just now. Try again in a moment.
secondFactor.useApp: Use the code from your app

recoveryUsed.used: You signed in with a recovery code.
recoveryUsed.noneLeft: You have no recovery codes left.
recoveryUsed.retired: Your authenticator app no longer works. Until you set it up again, only your recovery codes sign you in, and each works once.

recoveryCodes.title: Your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.lead: Each code works once. Keep them somewhere safe: we can't show them again.
recoveryCodes.copyFailed: Copying didn't work. Select the codes and copy them by hand.

security.lead: How your account is protected besides Google.
security.title: Two-step sign-in
security.loadFailed: We couldn't load your security settings.
security.refreshFailed: We couldn't refresh this, so it may be out of date.
security.offLead: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after Google. You also get recovery codes, so a lost phone does not lock you out.
security.activeLead: After Google, we ask for a code from your authenticator app.
security.retiredTitle: Your authenticator app no longer works.
security.retiredLead: A recovery code was used, so we stopped trusting the app. Set it up again to get a new key and ten new recovery codes.
security.noCodesLeft: You have no recovery codes left.

enableTotp.scanLead: Scan this code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Authy. On this device, open the link instead.
enableTotp.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
enableTotp.orType: Or type this key into the app:
enableTotp.codeHint: Type the six digits the app shows now, to check it works.
enableTotp.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Check your app and try again.
enableTotp.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
enableTotp.lost: Two-step sign-in is on, but your recovery codes didn't reach you. Ask for new ones before you leave.

disableTotp.ask: Turn off two-step sign-in? Your recovery codes stop working too.
disableTotp.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

reissueCodes.warning: This replaces all your recovery codes. The old ones stop working.
reissueCodes.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
